description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order under Revenue Protection Act, that Levy on Beedi  tobacco
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a Revenue Protection Order issued by the Minister of Finance and Mass Media under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962.
